3) Aditya (cc’d) will follow up with expected throughput profiles and recommended config for Dedicated vs Hosted.

Attached: Redwood-Commercial-Overview.pdf (high level pricing & deployment summary).

If that sounds right, please confirm preferred buying path (PO vs card vs marketplace) and we’ll tailor the commercial path accordingly.

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. A few quick answers from procurement/ops perspective: 

- Preferred commercial path: PO is our standard for anything >$50k / year. We can run a short pilot on card if needed, but procurement will want the final contract on PO.
- Marketplace: we prefer AWS Marketplace when possible; it simplifies procurement and entitlements.
- Security: please send SOC 2 Type II and the DPA. We may request vendor risk questionnaire answers as a follow-up.

On the deployment question, our infra team is leaning toward Dedicated for isolation, but we want a 60–90 day pilot to validate latency/cost before a 1yr commit. Can you provide estimated spend bands for:
  a) Hosted on-demand pilot (monthly estimate)
  b) Hosted 1yr committed (monthly committed price)
  c) Dedicated reserved 1yr (monthly committed price + setup)

Looping procurement@acme.com here to keep them in the thread — they’ll want the procurement checklist and any DocuSign/PO instructions.

—Jordan

Thanks Jordan — great, that helps a lot. I’ve attached a Procurement Readiness Checklist that maps required docs and typical timeline for PO workflow (procurement-readiness-checklist.xlsx). Highlights below: 

Pricing / packaging (high-level):
- Hosted (on-demand): No commit, pay-as-you-go per token / embedding. Good for pilots; flexible but unit cost higher.
- Hosted (committed): 12mo or 24mo commit for discounted per-unit pricing and reserved concurrency. Typical minimums depend on throughput; we’ll estimate based on your QPS.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): Customer-dedicated GPU pools with 1yr+ commit. Predictable throughput and data isolation; add-on for extended SLA and private networking. One-time setup fee may apply.
- Private / on-prem: For air-gapped or regulated deployments; longer onboarding and separate licensing.

Pilot suggestion: start with a 60–90 day hosted on-demand pilot to validate accuracy and latency. If Dedicated is required, we can run a mixed approach: pilot hosted, then migrate a defined workload to Dedicated as you commit.

I’ll pull together the spend bands for the three scenarios and send a short commercial options matrix by EOD PDT. Also adding our procurement checklist and the SOC 2 + DPA links in the follow-up.

Best,

Marissa

Quick technical note from my side:
- For your 50k QPS monthly profile with bursty traffic, Recommended config for Dedicated: 8xA100-style GPUs with autoscaling room for 25% headroom. Estimated throughput ~600 reqs/s per GPU depending on model size and sequence length.
- If you pilot hosted, we recommend enabling prefix caching and a KV cache for slower-changing histories to reduce token costs.
- We’ll need sample traffic and a typical prompt distribution to give tighter cost estimates.

Happy to hop on a short call with your infra team to walk through capacity planning.

—Aditya
